routing.instructions: You are routing one insurance claim to the unit that should handle it. Choose exactly one unit. Rule: if the claim shows at least two fraud warning signs (no verifiable documents, filed very soon after policy start, or an unusually large amount), route to special investigations regardless of claim type.

criteria.motor_unit: Vehicle accidents, hail, flood or parking damage to a car.
criteria.property_unit: Home damage: fire, water, storm, theft or structural damage.
criteria.health_benefits: Medical, dental, prescription or therapy cost reimbursement.
criteria.travel_unit: Trip cancellation, delay, lost baggage or interrupted travel.
criteria.special_investigations: Claims with repeated fraud warning signs needing review before payout.

fraud_review.instructions: Should this claim be flagged for special investigation before payout? Answer yes only when at least two fraud warning signs appear: missing verifiable documents, claim filed within 30 days of policy start, or an unusually large claimed amount.

urgency.instructions: How urgently should this claim be worked? critical: medical emergency or hospitalization involved. urgent: injury reported or the home is uninhabitable. priority: high-value claim or time-sensitive travel disruption. routine: everything else.

coverage_eligibility.instructions: Is this loss covered by the quoted policy? Rules: the incident must fall on or after the policy start date (earlier incidents are not covered). An incident within 2 days after policy start needs manual review before coverage is confirmed. Vehicle flood damage is covered only on Plus or Premium plans. Otherwise the loss is covered.

criteria.covered: Policy active for the incident and the peril is included in the plan.
criteria.not_covered_policy_not_active: The incident happened before the policy start date.
criteria.not_covered_peril_excluded: The plan tier excludes this peril (flood damage on Basic or Standard vehicle plans).
criteria.review_required: Incident within 2 days of policy start; a coverage check must precede any payment.

net_payable_band.instructions: After the plan deductible is applied, which band does the net payable amount fall into? Deductibles: motor USD 500, property USD 1,000, health USD 250, travel USD 100. If the claim is not covered or is held for special investigation, nothing is payable yet (USD 0).

criteria.zero_nothing_payable: Not covered, under review, or payout held for investigation.
criteria.up_to_1000: Net payable USD 1 - 1,000 after the deductible.
criteria.1000_to_5000: Net payable USD 1,001 - 5,000 after the deductible.
criteria.5000_to_15000: Net payable USD 5,001 - 15,000 after the deductible.
criteria.over_15000: Net payable over USD 15,000 after the deductible.

subrogation.instructions: Should the insurer pursue a third party to recover the payout (subrogation)? Answer yes only when a liable third party is identified in the claim: another driver rear-ended the customer, or a parking-garage collision with a police report naming the other party.

expected_touches.instructions: How many adjuster touches will this claim need? 0-1: complete, documented, low-value claim (straight-through candidate). 2: one complication - missing documents, high value (USD 8,800+), or a coverage check. 3: two complications. 4+: fraud-flagged or three complications.
